overview: The Medford School Committee approved an employment contract for the interim superintendent and approved a supplemental budget appropriation allocating voter-approved override funds to staffing, facilities, and collective bargaining reserves. The committee also received a review of FY25 budget reductions and honored outgoing Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent at her final meeting.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to conduct strategy regarding collective bargaining and contract negotiations for the interim superintendent.

items.title: Conflict of Interest Disclosure
items.summary: Member Intoppa read into the record an appearance of conflict of interest disclosure regarding family members employed in the district and state association membership.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Contract
items.summary: Approved the employment contract for the incoming interim superintendent of schools.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, capital purchases, grants, a high school field trip to Dartmouth Model UN, and the minutes of December 16, 2024.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent provided district announcements and delivered farewell reflections on her seven-year tenure.

items.title: Report on FY25 Budget Reductions
items.summary: Budget analyst Gerry McCue summarized how reductions and restorations across elementary, secondary, administrative, and nursing positions were implemented in the FY25 budget.

items.title: Supplemental Budget Appropriation
items.summary: Approved the supplemental appropriation allocating Questions 7 and 8 override funds toward restored positions, vocational staffing, special education inclusion, facilities, and collective bargaining reserves following public comment.

items.title: Condolence
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence in memory of Ralph A. Evangelista.

items.title: Recognition of Superintendent Edouard-Vincent
items.summary: Current and former committee members offered tributes and presented a gift honoring Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent for her service.
